scope: syntax-only quota-feasibility prototyping before P0 and target selection
permitted_inputs: source-module import and type syntax tokens
declaration_rule: Domain recognition uses path, declaration-header, and allowlisted module-wide import/type syntax signals.
If more than one of GRAPH, FINITE_ALGEBRA_EQUATIONAL, and AUTOMATA_GAME_PROCESS fires, classify as ambiguous.

For graph declarations, ordered tokens are tested only in the parsed outer conclusion relation after declaration binders and top-level implications; ordered tokens in hypotheses do not make a scalar stratum.
A GRAPH declaration plus an explicit finite signal with an outer ordered conclusion is GRAPH_SCALAR_INEQUALITY; graph declarations without an explicit finite signal are excluded.
A GRAPH declaration plus an explicit finite signal without an outer ordered conclusion is GRAPH_STRUCTURAL_PROPERTY.
A sole algebra signal plus an explicit finite signal is FINITE_ALGEBRA_EQUATIONAL; otherwise exclude.
A sole automata/game/process path, header, or module signal is AUTOMATA_GAME_PROCESS.
With no specialized signal but an explicit finite signal, use FINITE_COMBINATORIAL. Otherwise exclude as unclassified.

cluster_rule.eligible_only_if: all open declarations in the module receive the same non-ambiguous stratum
cluster_rule.cross_module_sibling_ambiguity: exclude during the provenance/identity gate; never split after randomness
